name: Tokaido

categories.label: Journey track points (during play)
categories.hint: All points scored immediately: souvenirs, panoramas, hot springs, meals, encounters, donations (1 per coin), panorama achievements.

categories.label: Panorama achievements held (already on track)
categories.labelVi: Thẻ thành tựu toàn cảnh (đã tính)
categories.hint: Each worth 3 points, scored when won. Not added again; used for tiebreak.

categories.label: End achievements won (Gourmet, Collector, Bather, Chatterbox)
categories.hint: 3 points each; each tied player scores on a tie.

categories.label: Coins donated to the temple
categories.hint: Rank among donors: 10/7/4, others 2; no donation scores nothing.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the most achievement cards wins.

endCondition.description: All travelers have arrived at the last inn in Edo.

notes: family: running-track. Traveler abilities and Crossroads expansion not modelled. Meals worth 6, hot springs 2-3, souvenir sets 1/3/5/7 per type are on the track during play.
